title: The Animal That Refuses to Die
hook: Your body suffocates in minutes without air, but one creature ignores oxygen entirely.
script: Your body suffocates in minutes without air, but one creature ignores oxygen entirely. How can a naked mole rat survive eighteen minutes without breathing? When air vanishes underground, its brain stops using normal glucose sugar. It switches its metabolism to burn fructose instead, functioning just like a plant. This trick keeps its brain alive, while dense sugar coats its cells to block cancer. A mouse dies in three years, but this rodent survives over thirty without aging like us. Would you trade normal looks for thirty years of immunity, or no?
